lead.t: Start urgently (within days) if: - CD4 <200 (high OI risk) - HIV-associated TB (with some caveats — see Week 10) - HIV-associated cryptococcal meningitis (delay ART 4–6 weeks to avoid IRIS!) - Pregnancy - HIV nephropathy
